topic: Top 5 affordable AI subscriptions to help run a small local business
audience: Hawaii small business owners, nonprofit staff, and local entrepreneurs

facts.claim: ChatGPT Plus costs $20/month, Claude Pro costs $20/month, and Google AI Pro costs $19.99/month
facts.detail: All three major individual AI subscriptions converged to nearly identical pricing in 2026. Each includes robust text generation, document analysis, and coding assistance. Accessible globally including Hawaii via web or mobile app.

facts.claim: Otter.ai free plan includes 300 minutes of automatic transcription per month
facts.detail: No credit card required. Real-time meeting transcription useful for capturing client calls, team standups, and interviews without manual note-taking. Actionable for solo entrepreneurs and small teams.

facts.claim: Zapier offers 15% discount on automation subscriptions for nonprofit organizations
facts.detail: Connects AI tools and automates workflows between apps. Discount applies to all paid plans. Reduces workflow automation cost for mission-driven organizations and nonprofits.

facts.claim: HubSpot CRM with AI features available free tier; includes AI-powered lead scoring and email automation
facts.detail: Free CRM tier available with AI capabilities. Nonprofit discounts available on paid tiers. Handles customer relationship management and basic sales automation without subscription cost.

facts.claim: AI software prices decreased 15% from 2024 to 2026 due to market competition
